notes: New: a full Teleprompter. Its own control panel and its own browser-source output, driven with the keys you already use - space to start and stop, left and right for speed, up and down to jump. Start a line with ## and it becomes a bookmark you can jump straight to. The mirrored output is a separate address, so beam-splitter glass in front of the lens and a confidence monitor at the back of the room run off one script at the same time and stay in step. The scroll position lives on the server like the presenter timer's clock, so screens cannot drift apart and a browser source that reloads mid-take comes back where the script is, not at the top. Play, pause, faster, slower and next-section are all on the Control API for Stream Deck.
